description: Before you connect to a server somebody handed you: does it answer, which of its tools actually respond when called with no arguments, what they charge, whether its card tries to instruct the agent reading it, and what changed in its tool list since the last look. Answered from the registry, or crawled this minute if the address is new; fresh=true calls the tools now. Every answer has a receipt address you can cite.

fresh.description: Call the tools now rather than answering from the last look (rationed per caller)

name: verify_endpoint
